record_title: Minimal branching degree is upper semicontinuous with saturated parity spectrum
limitations: The result does not compute the minimal branching degree for non-Hitchin representations or solve prescribed-signature realization. It gives no effective degree bounds, neighborhood radii, or description of the closed nowhere-dense jump locus. It concerns total branching degree only. The motivating preprint is very recent, so later revisions or unindexed parallel observations remain a residual originality risk.
